summary.text: Jeff LaRe is a Republican member of the Ohio House of Representatives for District 73 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia says he began his career in law enforcement in Fairfield County and later became an executive vice president of the Whitestone Group.

paragraphs.text: LaRe began his career as an Ohio Peace Officer Training Academy certified peace officer and corrections officer at the Fairfield County Sheriff's Office, and he also served as a deputy sheriff there.
He became executive vice president of the Whitestone Group in 2000, a position he still held as of the 2021 election, and he and his family lived in Violet Township in Fairfield County at that time.
LaRe assumed office in District 73 on January 1, 2023, and Ballotpedia lists his tenure in the Ohio House as beginning in 2019.
He defeated Mike Tussey in the March 19, 2024 Republican primary and Democrat Michael Scarmack in the November 5, 2024 general election.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists his committees as Arts, Athletics, and Tourism; Development; General Government, where he is vice chair; and Public Safety.
Whittney Wood is the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
